turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Thanks! The artist handles tattoo bookings personally, so a colleague will take over from here. In the chat we can't give prices or dates. If you'd like, send your idea, the size, the placement and your availability, and I'll pass them on.

rule.ro: Lucrările la comandă și programările pentru tatuaje le discută artista personal. Prin chat nu oferim prețuri și nici date.
rule.en: The artist answers commission and tattoo booking inquiries in person. The chat gives no price and no date.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a tattoo. No details given yet (idea, size, placement, availability). Artist to follow up personally; no price or date given.
